_doc: Ultimates are a separate system unlocked by story flag ult_unlocked. Each has evolution levels bought with milestone points (50-pt game, game winner, triple-double...). Round 55: the owner's set, Double Step-Back (PG/SG), Free-Throw-Line Dunk (SG/SF/PF), Chase-Down Block (PF/C). While your ult is active, the ult button (square) again = its fake, triangle = pass out (top levels).

deepStepback.name: Double Step-Back
deepStepback.desc: Around the 3PT line: two explosive step-backs into deep range; the three out of it ignores most of the contest.

levels.name: Double Step-Back
levels.info: Two step-backs; the deep three out of it is barely contested.

levels.name: Step-Back Step-Through
levels.info: □ again = a fake everyone bites on, then stick to the rim + ✕ = Step-Through (boosted finish).

levels.name: Step-Back Playmaker
levels.info: △ passes out of it (even in the air); the kick-out shot is wide open.

ftTakeoff.name: Free-Throw-Line Dunk
ftTakeoff.desc: Driving within ~20 ft: take off from the free-throw line and posterize everyone in front of you.

levels.name: Free-Throw-Line Poster
levels.info: Flies in from the line; on the make every defender in front of you gets posterized.

levels.name: Hang Time
levels.info: □ in the air = a stall fake: you hang, the jumpers come down, nobody can contest.

levels.name: Kick-Out
levels.info: △ in the air passes out right before the slam; the defense collapsed, so he's wide open.

chaseDown.name: Chase-Down Block
chaseDown.desc: Lock onto the ball: you run super fast and go up to block it almost no matter what.

levels.name: Chase-Down
levels.info: Locks onto the ball, super speed, blocks it ~93% of the time.

levels.name: Pinned to the Glass
levels.info: Pins it on the glass: your team keeps the ball.

levels.name: Swat & Go
levels.info: Grab it and go: your teammates leak out on the break and your next finish is boosted.
